I need to find the 59th business day starting from 2025-09-17 (Wednesday), excluding weekends and the specified holidays.

Let me write a Python script to calculate this:
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">cat > /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-RSI/ebd00391-ba98-5b98-9125-83abd1dce979/scratchpad/business_days.py << 'EOF'
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

start_date = datetime(2025, 9, 17)
holidays = {
    datetime(2025, 9, 29),
    datetime(2025, 10, 16),
    datetime(2025, 11, 7),
    datetime(2025, 11, 14),
    datetime(2025, 11, 18),
    datetime(2025, 12, 10),
    datetime(2025, 12, 26),
    datetime(2026, 1, 21),
    datetime(2026, 2, 18),
    datetime(2026, 2, 25),
    datetime(2026, 4, 3)
}

business_days = 0
current_date = start_date

while business_days < 59:
    # Check if current_date is a business day
    is_weekend = current_date.weekday() >= 5  # 5=Saturday, 6=Sunday
    is_holiday = current_date in holidays
    
    if not is_weekend and not is_holiday:
        business_days += 1
        if business_days == 59:
            break
    
    current_date += timedelta(days=1)

print(f"Last business day: {current_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}")
print(f"Day of week: {current_date.strftime('%A')}")
print(f"Business day count: {business_days}")
EOF
